notes.title: Big Update
notes.content:
Hello Primal players! In this last build of the game, we did a big update.

- Translations:
You can play the game in: English - Português - Chinese - Russian - French - Spanish - German

- Bug Fixing:
Main menu navationg is now more smooth
Enemies from all Levels are more balanced than before. 

- All the first 3 levels are unlocked.
After we saw a lot of gameplay varing different skills levels , we decide to unlock the first 3 levels so you can try them. But only the best players can enter in the Level 4, after complete all the 3 levels remains.

Thank you so much for your support!

Best regards,
Saulo Rosart

notes.title: Bug Fixing and Player's Upgrades Balanced
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37825138/4373dfab5559578a162ee74dbb026576d37c238d.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37825138/a0726bc5a3c1172758e861e6bee5cfc62a34f148.jpg[/img][/url]

Hello Primal players! In this update, we fix the Top of the Wolf achievement that was not working properly and made some new improvement on the options menus.

-Audio control: 
You can change the audio setting to configure what best fits your experience. 
- Achievement Top of the Wolf fixed 
- The player's Upgrades now are more balanced.

Thank you for playing it Primal Dungeon!
